review_candidates.title: IT Operations Manager
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The ideal candidate will have strong experience across infrastructure and systems administration, excellent troubleshooting capabilities, and the ability to lead IT operations while remaining technically involved in day-to-day operations. Key Responsibilities Manage and oversee day-to-day IT Operations and infrastructure services across the Group. Maintain hands-on involvement in troubleshooting complex infrastructure, systems, and operational issues. Manage and maintain servers, virtualization
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The role combines technical leadership and hands-on infrastructure management , ensuring the availability, reliability, security, performance, and continuity of critical IT systems and services. Maintain hands-on involvement in troubleshooting complex infrastructure, systems, and operational issues. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in computer science , Information Technology, Computer Engineering , or a related field. 4+ years of relevant experience in IT Operations, Infrastructure, Systems Administration, or Technical Team Management. Strong hands-on experience in IT infrastructure and systems administration . Strong leadership and team-management capabilities, with the ability to remain technically hands-on. If you are a hands-on IT professional with strong infrastructure expertise and a passion for improving IT operations and service reliability, we’d love to hear from you.
